content: I need to buy some clothes for my daughter. I don't know what size to get. Can you help me?
Certainly. How old is she? How tall is she?
She is 9 years old and 4 feet tall.
We have a great selection of clothes for young girls. Pants start at $10 and shirts start at $7.
Great. I will take 3 pairs of pants and 2 shirts, please.
If they're gifts, I can wrap each item for $1 each.
